name: episodic-lora-train-s45
description: C experiment: on-policy LoRA Qwen + memory head on shift episodes
command:
set -uo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish
V=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/.venv-sii
MODEL=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/qz/grouped_bce_4gpu_s44/v1/final
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
mkdir -p "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/logs/qz"
cd "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish"
test -f "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data_shift_v5/train.jsonl" && test -f "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data_shift_v5/dev.jsonl" || { echo "missing raw shift episodes"; exit 3; }
"$V/bin/python" harness/train_episodic_lora.py --train-jsonl "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data_shift_v5/train.jsonl" --dev-jsonl "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data_shift_v5/dev.jsonl" --qwen-model "$MODEL" --modules "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/innerjev/configs/4B/modules.json" --output "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_lora_v1_s45" --lora-r 16 --lora-alpha 32 --inner-steps 4 --latent-dim 128 --epochs 2 --limit 200 --lr 1e-4 --accumulate-episodes 1 --seed 45 --device cuda > "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/logs/qz/episodic_lora_train_s45.log" 2>&1
status=$?; echo "JOB EXIT=$status"; exit $status
